posts.title: Sixth year of being a GitHub Star
posts.description: My GitHub Star status was renewed for the sixth year making it quite the journey already since the beginning all the way back in 2021.

posts.title: meet.js Summit 2026
posts.description: Last week, on March 4th, the 15th anniversary edition of the meet.js Summit was happening in Warsaw - I was attending the conference and representing the Gamedev.js community.

posts.title: I went all-in into Warhammer
posts.description: In 2025, the same year I achieved so much around Neuroshima Hex, I also dived deep into Warhammer and went through a few different settings in the span of twelve months: from Age of Sigmar, Warhammer 40 000, to The Old World, Kill Team, and even Necromunda.
